[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Kaaver Tapps''' was [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] most trusted aide. Tapps was placed in charge of composing a [[Situational Analysis in the Naboo System|comprehensive dossier]] to prepare [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] for negotiations with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the wake of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Blockade of Naboo]].
